verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a SaaS tax-compliance platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only on-demand tax calculation, transaction, nexus and MCP tool calls. No evidence item mentions schedules, cron-style triggers or recurring workflow execution. The Managed Returns item about embedding filing 'into their workflows' describes partner integration, not a recurring scheduler.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
